metadata.title: OSA-MCI locked random-forest model and Shiny calculator reproducibility package
metadata.description: Publication-lock code, locked random-forest model object, Shiny source, prediction examples, variable dictionary, software-concordance checks, and software/session information supporting a multicenter cross-sectional diagnostic-prediction study of concurrent mild cognitive impairment among Chinese patients with obstructive sleep apnea. Patient-level datasets are not included because of privacy and institutional-governance restrictions.
